notes.title: The first major update is here! "Industrial Strength" Part I
notes.content:
[h1]Announcing Starscraper 1.1:  "Industrial Strength" Update Part I.[/h1]

Welcome! In the two months since StarScraper released, there has been so much we wanted to add and improve that we had trouble fitting it all into one update. So much so, in fact, that we decided to put together one big Industrial-strength one!

Since before we released we’d been wanting to add more dimension to the resource side of our tower simulation. What’s the fun if there’s only one dimension to how rich you are(n’t)? Therefore, we focused this update on adding industry to your skyscraper. Now, not only can you build up your tower, you can also build up massive supply chains and stockpiles of consumer goods for your stores!

We also have been hard at work improving the game’s ease-of-use and clarity. We've also added over 25 new rooms, with new mechanics to help differentiate them from the rest!

We still have a little bit more in store, so this will be part I of a II part update. We're also adding some more secret cool content in Part II, but we want a little bit of time to make sure everything in Part I works first. We've added a lot, so we're  going to keep an eye on it's performance as we polish the second half of the update.

Check out the changelog below for everything that's in the game right now!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h2]Gameplay Mechanics[/h2]
[*] 	[h3]New System: Industry[/h3]
[list]
[*] 		Added In-game industrial resources.
[*] 		Added a production system. Rooms can now consume, produce, and buy resources.
[*] 		Added a resource inventory. 
[/list]
[*] 	[h3]Disasters & Dynamic Effects[/h3]
[list]
[*] 		Infestation
[*] 		Water Leaks
[*] 		Improved Fire system.
[*] 		Disasters now cause room damage per cell.
[*] 		New Containment rooms can now insulate sensitive rooms against damage.
[/list]
[*] [h2]User Interface and Ease-of-Use[/h2]
[list]
[*] 	Added interaction modes (“Building Tools”) to improve control scheme.
[*] 	Added Interactive Minimap
[*] 	Camera no longer pans when the game is not in focus
[*] 	Camera edge scrolling margin reduced
[*] 	Increased UI transition speeds
[*] 	Reworked Tooltip system to show more information
[*] 	Change Tooltip font for improved readability
[*] 	Added new "?" mouseover tips to  better explain game mechanics
[*] 	Reworked UI visuals for readability
[*] 	Updated tooltips and Tip Book for better clarity and for new systems and content.
[*] 	Added an new game story introduction
[/list]
[*] 	[h3]Data Visualization[/h3]
[list]
[*] 		New Data Maps for Room Evaluation and Infestation Risk
[*] 		Added new icons for Data Maps
[/list]
[*] 	[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] 		Reduced the rent of Server Rooms
[*] 		Reduced the rent of Offices
[/list]
[*] [h2]Added New Rooms[/h2]

[*] 	[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

notes.title: Version 1.0 is here!
notes.content:
It's been one week since the launch of StarScraper, and we haven't been resting on our laurels. We already released a path earlier in the week with a few fixes, but here's a much more important and bigger update.

[h3]Major Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial [/b]- We've added a full gameplay tutorial!
[*] [b]Light Switches[/b]- Rooms light up and go dark based on activity and time.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs and Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]UI Improvements[/b] - We cleaned up the UI to make it easier to use and more stylish.
[*] [b]Tooltip Improvements[/b] - We cleaned up the tool tips tot be easier to understand.
[*] [b]Visualization Colors[/b] - Data visualization colors are now consistent. Blue is good, red is bad.
[*] [b](Bug) Steam Achievements[/b] - They didn't work. (fixed)
[*] [b](Bug) Things turn invisible[/b] - People and rooms occasionally turned invisible. (fixed)
[*] [b](Bug) Elevators stuck between floors[/b] - On speed 4x, elevators got stuck. (fixed)
[/list]

That takes care of a lot of boring, but important changes! Now the game will be better for everyone, clearing the way for us to add more game-play significant features for our 1.1 patch, alongside Mac support!

We have a lot more to do, but stay tuned. And as always, if you have a suggestion we're happy to listen and make this game as good as it can be.

Until next time!


[h3]Current Planned Roadmap:[/h3]
[h3]Releases[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Japanese Localization[/b] - We're fully localizing the game to Japanese audiences.
[*] [b]Mac OS Release[/b] - We're releasing on Mac!
[/list]
[h3]Major Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tenant Thought Bubbles[/b] - See what a tenant is thinking, wants, and where they're going.
[*] [b]Tenant Room Interactions[/b] - Tenants will interact visibly with rooms.
[*] [b]Room Occupancy & Data[/b] - Click on a room to see a popup with extra details
[*] [b]Hotel Room Infestations[/b]- Pest control and infestation mechanics for hotels and possibly more.
[*] [b]Express Elevators[/b]- You can choose which floors they stop at.
[*] [b]Name Rooms[/b]- Rename individual rooms and businesses.
[*] [b]Sound Ambiance[/b]- All rooms will have sound effects to bring the tower to life.
[/list]
[h3]New Rooms[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Security Category[/b] - This category includes security and protects against crime.
[*] [b]More Transportation[/b] - Monorail, subway, and bus stations.
[*] [b]Pest Control and other services [/b]- Service rooms that have an active effect on your tower.
[/list]

notes.title: StarScraper Road Map!
notes.content:
We want to support StarScraper for a long time, and make it the game it has the potential to be. We've got our work cut out for us, but we're excited to see it improve as well. Here's a sneak preview of what's coming down the road for the future of Starscraper.

[h3]Major Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tenant Thought Bubbles[/b] - See what a tenant is thinking, wants, and where they're going.
[*] [b]Tenant Room Interactions[/b] - Tenants will interact visibly with rooms.
[*] [b]Room Occupancy & Data[/b] - Click on a room to see a popup with extra details
[*] [b]Tutorial [/b]- In addition to the tip book, we're going to add a full and proper tutorial.
[*] [b]Hotel Room Infestations[/b]- Pest control and infestation mechanics for hotels and possibly more.
[*] [b]Express Elevators[/b]- You can choose which floors they stop at.
[*] [b]Light Switches[/b]- Rooms light up and go dark based on activity and time.
[*] [b]Name Rooms[/b]- Rename individual rooms and businesses.
[/list]
[h3]New Rooms[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Security Category[/b] - This category includes security and protects against crime.
[*] [b]More Transportation[/b] - Monorail, subway, and bus stations.
[*] [b]Pest Control and other services [/b]- Service rooms that have an active effect on your tower.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs and Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Steam Achievements[/b] - Don't currently activate.
[*] [b]Things turn invisible[/b] - People and rooms occasionally turn invisible until a menu is opened.
[*] [b]Elevators stuck between floors[/b] - On speed 4x, elevators get stuck in tall buildings.
[/list]

We will be adding on to this list as we decide what is most important to add, and how we should add them. If you have any suggestions, comment below and we'll do what we can to make them happen.

Stay tuned, and thanks again for your support with our first launch!

notes.title: First Updates and Fixes!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has shown so much interest in StarScraper since its release! Thanks to that interest, we've gotten a lot of great feedback and we wanted to show our appreciation by using it to make StarScraper more awesome, fun, and easy to pick up. This first update here focuses on usability and polish, fixing a lot of small but important features and systems for a stronger gameplay experience.

Here's the changelog for version 0.9.1.1:

Rooms
- Added a janitorial closet for trash cleanup
- Lowered fame requirement of Primary School

Balance Adjustments
- Dramatically reduced the rate of trash accumulation
- Reduced the size of bags of trash
- Reduced payout for trash cleanup

UI Adjustments
- Adjusted camera pan speed and margin
- Added hotkeys top open and close menus
- Added the ability to pause and unpause by pressing Space
- Added the ability to slow down time with right click, and speed up time with left click on Coffee Cup
- Added a notification to show you where tips are for the first time you play
- Can now move the camera when a dialog box is open
- Can now see the evaluation rating of rooms in the build menu
- Consolidated maintainance tools into build menu
- Added the ability to disable visualizations in data menu
- Adjusted tooltips to be more comprehensible

UX Adjustments
- Game now starts in Fullscreen mode
- Corrected tips to accurately represent gameplay

Bug Fixes
-Fixed WASD and other letters being added into dialog boxes incorrectly


Thanks for playing!
